core_obligations: Dispose of the cited parts: part (1) is the same-chapter weak association statement for pushforwards and part (2) follows from it together with the relation between associated and weakly associated primes, exactly as the author writes (proof lines 964-965).

Prove part (3) by the Ext criterion: show that the group of homomorphisms from the residue field to the localised pushforward and its first Ext both vanish, reduce to the injectivity of the restriction map from the local ring to its maximal ideal by the standard exact sequence, and use flat base change, adjunction, and the fact that the pulled-back maximal ideal is the whole structure sheaf because the point is not in the image (proof lines 967-995).

Prove part (4): after flat base change to the spectrum of the local ring, a nonzerodivisor a on the base gives a short exact sequence on S and, because F is flat over S, a short exact sequence on X; pushing forward gives the injectivity of multiplication by a on the pushforward and an inclusion of the quotient into the pushforward of the quotient (proof lines 997-1022).

Prove part (5): the same argument applied to the quotient by a shows that a nonzerodivisor b on the quotient ring acts injectively on the pushforward of the quotient, and the inclusion just obtained makes it act injectively on the quotient of the pushforward by a as well (proof lines 1023-1028).
Prove part (6): the two preceding parts together with the definition of depth give the stated lower bound for the depth of the localised pushforward (proof lines 1029-1031).
proof_roadmap: Parts (1) and (2) are the author's citations of earlier results, which the counted text states as such (proof lines 964-965).

Part (3) is proved through the Ext criterion for depth two, using flat base change and adjunction to reduce to the vanishing statement forced by the point being outside the image (proof lines 967-995).

Parts (4) to (6) are proved by pushing the Koszul-type short exact sequences of a nonzerodivisor, and then of a regular sequence of length two, through the flat module F and out along f_* (proof lines 997-1031).
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six statements about the localised pushforward (f_*F)_s of a quasi-coherent module along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism, at a point s outside the image of f: weak associatedness, associatedness, depth at least two, and then nonzerodivisor and depth statements under the extra hypothesis that F is flat over S (statement lines 938-961). The counted proof has real content in parts (3) to (6): part (3) is proved by the Ext criterion for depth, with flat base change reducing to the spectrum of the local ring and adjunction together with the pulled-back maximal ideal being the whole structure sheaf, and parts (4) to (6) are proved by pushing the short exact sequences cut out by a nonzerodivisor, and then by a regular sequence of length two, through the flat module F and out along the pushforward (proof lines 967-1031). It is H2: the arguments are local algebra of moderate length carried out in the counted span, but there is no independent research-level content, and the author's own parts (1) and (2) are citations rather than proofs.
